appearanceReset.title: Reset appearance
appearanceReset.intro: This page always renders the shipped default appearance, regardless of what your tenant or account has saved — it is the escape hatch if a saved theme has made the rest of the application hard to use.

appearanceReset.personalSignInPrompt: Sign in to reset your personal preference.
appearanceReset.tenantDescription: Removes your tenant's custom branding entirely, so every user without a personal override sees the system default again. Requires the "Manage appearance" permission.

appearanceReset.tenantSignInPrompt: Sign in with the Manage appearance permission to reset tenant branding.

tenants.suspendedNotice: Tenant "⁨{slug}⁩" suspended — every live session was ended.
tenants.deprovisionedNotice: Tenant "⁨{slug}⁩" deprovisioned — all four stores torn down and verified gone.

branding.noTenantsBody: No tenant is currently Active or Suspended — there is nothing to brand yet.

reset.forbiddenBody: This screen is only available to the platform operator's own tenant.
reset.personalDescription: Clears your own personal appearance preference. This never affects any tenant's branding.

reset.noTenantSelected: Open this page from the Branding screen's Reset link so a tenant is selected.

uploadError.tooLarge: That file is too large. Brand images must be 1 MB or smaller.
uploadError.noTenantBranding: Save your colour scheme once before uploading a logo or favicon.

layout.notYetCustomisable: Set platform-wide for both shipped skins; not yet a tenant-customisable setting.

modeDirection.directionTenantNote: An organisation must commit to one direction; "follow locale" is only available as your own personal preference.

users.removeConfirmDescription: "⁨{name}⁩" will lose access to this entity's backoffice. They can be invited again later.

roles.ruleSummary: Agent Designer can build but not publish. Publishing is an Entity Admin action — separation of duties between authoring and release.
roles.separationConfirmDescription: Granting "⁨{roleLabel}⁩" the ability to publish agents breaks the separation of duties this screen enforces: Agent Designer can build but not publish, and publishing is an Entity Admin action.
roles.protectedCellNotice: The Super Admin grant for "Manage users & teams" cannot be revoked — every entity needs at least one role that can manage its own users.

registry.permissionDeniedBody: Managing agents requires the Agent Designer role or above.

registry.emptyState: No agents yet. Create one to get started.
registry.archiveConfirmDescription: "⁨{name}⁩" will be archived and removed from every channel it is bound to.

agent.bound_to_live_channel: This agent is bound to a live channel and cannot be archived.
agent.version_is_current: This is already the current version.

new.signInPrompt: Sign in to create an agent.
new.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
new.permissionDeniedBody: Creating agents requires the Agent Designer role or above.
new.intro: Start with a name and description — the rest of the wizard opens once the agent exists.
new.descriptionHint: Optional. Shown in the registry and to other designers.

newWithAi.signInPrompt: Sign in to create an agent with AI.
newWithAi.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
newWithAi.permissionDeniedBody: Creating agents requires the Agent Designer role or above.
newWithAi.intro: Describe the business need this agent should handle, in plain language. The AI will propose a name, instructions, model, tools, knowledge, guardrails, channels, and a starting conversation flow for you to review before anything is created.
newWithAi.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the business need this agent should handle…
newWithAi.flowInstructionHelp: Plain language describing the conversation — a sentence or two is usually enough, but if your description included a menu, FAQ list, or escalation policy, the fuller detail is kept here too. This is used to build the starting flow once the agent is created.
newWithAi.resultPartialNotice: The agent was created, but not everything could be applied — finish the remaining steps in the wizard below.
newWithAi.resultSuccessNotice: The agent was created with everything proposed.

wizard.signInPrompt: Sign in to edit this agent.
wizard.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
wizard.permissionDeniedBody: Editing agents requires the Agent Designer role or above.
wizard.notFoundBody: This agent doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

publishError.gate_blocked: ⁨{agentName}⁩ ⁨{versionLabel}⁩ is blocked by the publish gate — ⁨{reasons}⁩

gateReason.suiteFailure: No completed regression run exists yet for this version.

publishError.flow_not_ready: This agent's flow isn't ready to publish: ⁨{reason}⁩

flows.already_published: its flow version is already published.
flows.entry_node_required: set an entry node before publishing — the flow needs a real starting point.
flows.escape_node_required: set an escape node before publishing — a citizen must always be able to reach a graceful exit.
flows.escape_path_unreachable: add a Condition node a citizen can always reach, so they can break out into plain conversation (no reachable free-text escape, R3).

knowledge.intro: Let this agent draw on the tenant's knowledge base when answering — sources and retrieval settings are managed on the Knowledge / Graph RAG screen.
knowledge.collectionDescription: Enable this to let the agent search indexed sources for grounding its answers.

flows.noNodesCause: Add a node to start building this flow.
flows.noEdgesCause: Add a connection to link two nodes together.
flows.selectNodeHint: Select a node on the canvas to set it as this flow's entry or escape point, or delete it.
flows.aiSidebarIntro: Describe the change you want in plain language. The AI proposes a plan — nothing changes until you review and apply it.
flows.aiSidebarEmpty: Describe a change below, e.g. "Add a question asking for the bill number after the greeting."
flows.aiComposerAriaLabel: Describe a flow change to the AI
flows.aiPlanReadyFallback: Here's a proposed set of changes — review them below.
flows.aiNoChangesProposed: No changes were proposed for that request.
flows.aiPlanRejected: Proposed changes rejected — nothing was changed.
flows.aiApplyFailed: Could not apply the proposed changes: ⁨{detail}⁩
flows.fieldSlotNameHelp: The name this answer is stored under, for later nodes to reference.
flows.fieldOptionSourceKindHelp: Where the answer options come from: a fixed list you write below, entity labels already in the knowledge graph, or the result of an earlier tool call.
flows.fieldOptionSourceRefHelp: The knowledge graph entity label, or the tool result field, that supplies the options for this question.
flows.fieldOptionSourceRefHelpAriaLabel: More information about Option source reference
flows.fieldStaticOptionsJsonHelp: The answers a citizen can pick from, e.g. "Yes" and "No". Type one, press Enter, then add the next.
flows.fieldStaticOptionsJsonPlaceholder: Type an option and press Enter…
flows.fieldToolBindingHelp: Which bound tool this step calls. Only tools already enabled for this agent appear here — bind one first under Tools & MCP registry if the one you need is missing.
flows.fieldRetryCountHelp: How many times to retry this tool call before falling through.
flows.fieldOnFailureNodeHelp: Where the flow continues if this tool call ultimately fails.
flows.fieldHandoverReasonHelp: Why the flow hands off to a human agent here — recorded on the escalation ticket so the human agent sees the same reason.
flows.fieldRequiredAssuranceHelp: The minimum identity-verification level a citizen must have reached before this step can run. Leave unset to allow anonymous citizens through.
flows.fieldConditionExpressionHelp: A real expression evaluated against the flow's current slots to decide which branch to take next — e.g. amount > 500.
flows.fieldIsDefaultBranch: Default branch (used when no other condition matches)

flows.invalid_node: This node isn't valid — check the fields below.
flows.invalid_edge: This connection isn't valid — check the fields below.
flows.endpoint_wrong_version: One of this connection's nodes belongs to a different flow version.

test.sandboxNotice: Sandbox — this doesn't create any real citizen data, and any real external tool call is simulated rather than actually invoked.
test.intro: Try a real conversation against the current draft of this flow before publishing it.
test.emptyTranscript: Send a message below to start testing this flow.
test.composerPlaceholder: Type a message to test the flow…

identity.ownerHelp: Fixed at creation — an agent's owning entity never changes.

model.fallbackModelHelp: Optional. Used if the primary model is unavailable.

channels.intro: Choose which channels this agent is reachable on.

guardrails.defaultReason: Set from the agent designer wizard.

governance.policy_locked: This guardrail is locked and cannot be changed.

publish.noPublishPermission: Publishing requires the Entity Admin role — you can save this draft for an Entity Admin to publish.
publish.blockedIntro: This agent can't be published yet:

missingStep.identity: Identity is incomplete — give this agent a name.
missingStep.channels: No channel is enabled yet — enable at least one in the Channels step.

tools.registeredNotCallableRule: Registered ≠ callable — a discovered tool is only invocable by an agent once explicitly bound here.

skills.emptyCause: This tenant has no skills in its tool registry yet. Register one in the tool registry, then come back to attach it to this agent.

mcp.emptyCause: This tenant has no MCP servers in its tool registry yet. Register one in the tool registry, then come back to connect and bind its tools.

discoveryError.tls: The server's TLS certificate couldn't be verified.
discoveryError.protocol: The server responded with an unexpected protocol.
discoveryError.empty: The server connected but exposed no tools.

connectors.emptyCause: This tenant has no API connectors in its tool registry yet. Register one in the tool registry, then come back to attach it to this agent.

tools.server_not_connected: This server isn't connected — connect & discover first.
tools.target_soft_deleted: This item has been deleted and can no longer be attached.

aiSettings.pageDescription: The model the Flow Designer's AI sidebar uses to propose flow edits, for this tenant.
aiSettings.signInPrompt: Sign in to change the AI assistant's model.
aiSettings.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
aiSettings.permissionDeniedBody: Changing the AI assistant's model requires a permission your role does not hold.
aiSettings.primaryModelHelp: The model identifier sent to OpenRouter, e.g. "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5".
aiSettings.fallbackModelHelp: Used only if the primary model is unavailable when a proposal is requested.
aiSettings.savedNotice: Saved. New proposals will use this model.

tools.signInPrompt: Sign in to manage skills, MCP servers, API connectors and circuit breakers.
tools.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
tools.permissionDeniedBody: Managing the tool registry requires the ability to manage agents — the same permission the agent builder uses.

skills.heading: Skills catalogue
skills.boundVersionsNote: Bound agent versions is a count across the whole estate. Attaching a skill to a particular agent version happens in the agent builder's tools step, so that one screen owns the decision.
skills.fieldSchemaHelp: A JSON Schema object describing the arguments an agent may pass.
skills.fieldAttachedByDefault: Attach to new agent versions by default
skills.deleteConfirmDescription: "⁨{name}⁩" will be removed from the catalogue. Agent versions that already bind it must be unbound first.
skills.deleteInUseError: This skill cannot be deleted: ⁨{count}⁩ agent version(s) still bind it. Unbind it in the agent builder first.

mcpServers.heading: MCP servers
mcpServers.fieldEndpointHelp: The MCP endpoint this server is reached on.
mcpServers.fieldCredentialSecretRefHelp: A reference to the stored secret. Never paste the secret itself into this field.
mcpServers.discoveryServerNotFound: This server is no longer registered — it may have been deleted in another session.
mcpServers.discoveryFailedDns: The server's hostname could not be resolved.
mcpServers.discoveryFailedTls: The TLS handshake with this server failed.
mcpServers.discoveryFailedTimeout: The server did not respond in time.
mcpServers.discoveryFailedProtocol: The server responded, but not with a valid MCP handshake.
mcpServers.discoveryEmpty: The server connected but advertised no tools.
mcpServers.discoveryRuntimeUnavailable: MCP discovery is not available yet: ⁨{detail}⁩
mcpServers.noToolsDiscovered: No tools discovered from this server yet.
mcpServers.deleteConfirmDescription: "⁨{name}⁩" and its discovered tools will be removed from the registry. Agent versions that bind its tools must be unbound first.
mcpServers.deleteInUseError: This server cannot be deleted: ⁨{count}⁩ agent version(s) still bind its tools. Unbind them in the agent builder first.

apiConnectors.heading: API connectors
apiConnectors.projectedSkillNote: Every connector also appears in the skills catalogue as a paired, read-only skill, which is what agents actually call. Bound agent versions is a count across the whole estate; attaching a connector to a particular agent version happens in the agent builder's tools step.
apiConnectors.testNotImplemented: Connection testing isn't wired up yet, so "⁨{name}⁩" was not called. There is no outbound request path in this environment; the connector's test state is unchanged.
apiConnectors.fieldUrlTemplateHelp: Placeholders in braces are filled from the agent's arguments at call time.
apiConnectors.rateLimitHelp: Required for a new connector, and set once here: it decides how often agents may call this API and what counts as one caller.
apiConnectors.deleteConfirmDescription: "⁨{name}⁩" and its paired skill will be removed from the registry. Agent versions that already bind it must be unbound first.
apiConnectors.deleteInUseError: This connector cannot be deleted: ⁨{count}⁩ agent version(s) still bind it. Unbind it in the agent builder first.

circuitBreakers.heading: Resilience & fallbacks
circuitBreakers.fallbackApologiseOfferLiveAgent: Apologise and offer a live agent
circuitBreakers.fieldServeCachedWhenDown: Serve cached answers while this source is down
circuitBreakers.fieldCachedAnswerMaxAgeHelp: Leave empty for no age limit.
circuitBreakers.fieldDegradedModeHelp: Shown to citizens while this breaker is open.
circuitBreakers.tripDialogDescription: This opens the breaker for "⁨{name}⁩" immediately, so its fallback path takes over until the cooldown elapses.
circuitBreakers.fieldTripReasonHelp: Required by the trip operation. It is not stored anywhere yet — no free-text field exists on the breaker event record — so treat it as a note to whoever is watching, not an audit trail.
circuitBreakers.breakerNotFoundError: This breaker is no longer registered — it may have been deleted in another session.
circuitBreakers.ruleSummaryBreakerPurpose: Without a breaker, a slow dependency stalls every conversation that touches it. Tripped services fail fast to the fallback instead of holding the user.
circuitBreakers.ruleSummarySeededOpen: The SEWA bill API breaker is seeded Open, matching the Degraded status shown in Observability — one incident, visible in two places.

knowledge.signInPrompt: Sign in to manage knowledge sources, the entity graph and retrieval tuning.
knowledge.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
knowledge.permissionDeniedBody: Managing the knowledge base requires the Knowledge Manager role.

sources.heading: Knowledge sources
sources.fetchNotWiredNote: Document sources are fully wired: pasted text is chunked, embedded and indexed for real. The other four source types (URL crawler, Database, SharePoint, API feed) are real, persisted, schedulable rows — this wave does not build their fetch mechanics yet, so they stay at 0% indexed until a later wave adds them.
sources.fieldLocationHelp: Where this source is fetched from. Not used by fetch mechanics this wave — recorded for when they are built.
sources.fieldDocumentTextHelp: Chunked and indexed immediately on save.
sources.nonDocumentCreateNote: This source type is saved as a real, schedulable row, but this wave does not fetch its content — it will stay at 0% indexed.
sources.removeConfirmDescription: "⁨{name}⁩" and its chunks will be removed from the system of record. Entities supported only by this source are also removed from the graph.

knowledge.source_not_found: This source is no longer registered — it may have been removed in another session.
knowledge.recrawl_not_supported_for_source_type: Re-crawl is only wired for Document sources this wave.
knowledge.no_stored_text_to_recrawl: There is no stored text to re-crawl for this source.

graph.noEntitiesCause: Add a source under Sources and index it to populate the entity graph.
graph.noEntitiesMatchCause: Try a different name, or clear the search to see every entity.
graph.noDuplicatesCause: Run "Detect duplicates" to scan the current entity type for likely duplicates.
graph.fieldCanonicalKeyHelp: A stable, unique identifier for this entity, e.g. "sewa-connection-fee".

knowledge.parent_node_not_found: The named parent entity could not be found.

graph.mergeDialogDescription: ⁨{duplicateLabel}⁩ will be merged into ⁨{primaryLabel}⁩. This cannot be undone.

knowledge.candidate_not_found: This candidate is no longer available — it may have already been resolved in another session.
knowledge.candidate_not_open: This candidate has already been resolved.

fast.label: Fast
fast.description: Smaller chunks and fewer candidates — quicker answers, less context per answer.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: The recommended starting point for most tenants.

thorough.label: Thorough
thorough.description: Larger chunks and more candidates — slower, but draws on more context per answer.

retrieval.presetActiveCustom: Custom — one or more advanced settings were changed by hand.
retrieval.fieldEmbeddingModelHelp: Changing this requires a full re-index — every vector in a collection must come from the same model.
retrieval.modelChangeQueuedNotice: Retrieval configuration saved. Changing the embedding model queued a full re-index job — see the job history below.
retrieval.modelChangeConfirmBody: Changing the embedding model or its dimension queues a full re-index of every source in this collection. Vectors from two different models can never coexist, so nothing is retrievable from the old model once this is saved.

knowledge.weights_must_sum_to_one: Graph and vector weighting must add up to 100%.
knowledge.overlap_must_be_less_than_chunk_size: Chunk overlap must be smaller than chunk size.

knowledge.reindex_already_running: A tenant-wide re-index is already running.

conflicts.heading: Source conflicts
conflicts.fieldDefaultPolicyHelp: Applies only to automatic resolution — a human choosing a side with "Make authoritative" is always allowed, regardless of this setting.
conflicts.policySaveError: This policy could not be saved.

knowledge.conflict_not_open: This conflict is no longer open.

demoPage.missingChannelKeyOutro: to the URL to preview a real channel's widget.

composer.pausedReason: A live agent has joined this conversation.

diagnostics.traceEmptyCause: Send a message to see the routing decision, tools invoked and pending slot.

mic.unsupportedReason: Voice input isn't available in this browser.

channels.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this page
channels.permissionDeniedBody: Managing channels requires the "Manage agents" permission.

channels.heading: Channels
channels.agentRequiredError: Going Live requires a bound agent.
channels.handoverHoursMissing: Out-of-hours behaviour has not been configured yet.

handoverHours.heading: Out-of-hours behaviour
handoverHours.fieldAssistantAvailable247: Keep the assistant available 24/7, even when agents are offline
handoverHours.fieldOfferEscalationOutsideHours: Offer escalation to a human agent outside staffed hours
handoverHours.fieldNoAgentAvailableMessage: Message shown when no agent is available

errors.handoverRequiresAssistantAvailable: Escalation cannot be offered outside staffed hours while the assistant itself refuses sessions outside hours — turn on "Keep the assistant available 24/7" first, or turn this off.

widgetStudio.notProvisioned: The web widget channel has not been provisioned yet.
widgetStudio.domainInvalidError: Enter a host or a single-label wildcard (e.g. *.sharjah.ae) — no scheme, path, IP or bare TLD.
widgetStudio.domainAllowlistEmptyWhileLiveError: Cannot remove the last allowed domain while the widget channel is Live.
widgetStudio.openLivePreviewHelp: Opens this widget on a real page served from this app — the honest way to test the copied snippet. Saving the snippet into a local file and opening it directly will always fail: a local file's origin is never on the allowed-domains list above, by design.

whatsapp.notProvisioned: The WhatsApp channel has not been provisioned yet.

connect.heading: Connect WhatsApp
connect.explanation: No WhatsApp Business Account is connected to this tenant yet. Enter its real Meta Cloud API details below to connect it — this does not call Meta's API; it records the configuration this app needs to send and receive messages.
connect.fieldPhoneNumberIdHelp: From the WhatsApp Business Account's Meta Cloud API settings, not the phone number itself.
connect.fieldCredentialSecretRefHelp: A reference to where the real access token is stored (env:NAME, k8s:..., or vault:...) — never the token itself.
connect.fieldWebhookVerifySecretRefHelp: A reference to where the real webhook verify token is stored — same convention as above.

channels.whatsapp_already_connected: This channel is already connected — use the settings below to update it.
channels.secret_ref_invalid: Both secret references must start with env:, k8s: or vault: — never a real secret value.

whatsapp.bspTemplateIdPrompt: Enter the BSP (Meta) template id to record with this approval:
whatsapp.sessionWindowReadOnly: Session window: ⁨{hours}⁩ hours — free-form replies allowed after a user message; a template is required to re-open after this. Pinned by Meta's own platform rule.
whatsapp.templateDuplicateNameError: A template with this name already exists for this locale.
whatsapp.templatePlaceholderMismatchError: The number of placeholders in the body must match the number of variables.

campaigns.quietHoursError: The whole quiet-hours window is currently closed for sends.
campaigns.templateNotApprovedGenericError: This campaign's template is not Approved.

localization.fallbackLocaleRequiredError: Exactly one locale must remain the fallback.

escalations.signInPrompt: Sign in to work the escalation queue or manage routing rules.

routingRules.noMatch: No rule matched — falls to the default queue.
routingRules.serverDefault: Recorded test result: falls to the default queue (⁨{route}⁩)
routingRules.differsFromSaved: This reflects an unsaved change — the persisted order differs.

evaluation.permissionDeniedBody: Managing evaluation requires a permission your role does not hold.

goldenSets.emptyDescription: Create a golden set, or add a conversation to one from the command centre's conversation explorer.

regressionRuns.emptyDescription: Run a golden set from the Golden sets tab, or Run all suites once a run exists for at least one set.

publishGate.blockOnSuiteFailure: Block publish when a suite fails

publishGate.consequenceOff: Any agent can be published regardless of test results.
publishGate.consequenceOnNoBlock: Gate is active. No agent version is currently blocked.

governance.signInPrompt: Sign in to manage environments, promotions, the audit log, observability and privacy settings.
governance.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
governance.permissionDeniedBody: Managing governance requires a permission your role does not hold.

auditLog.caption: Audit log
auditLog.emptyCause: Configuration changes, publishes, permission grants and data exports will appear here.
auditLog.selectAPrompt: Select an entry to see its full detail.

environments.environmentsEmptyCause: Environments are seeded at platform provisioning.
environments.pendingEmptyCause: A promotion request will appear here once someone requests one.

observability.heading: Service health
observability.caption: Service health
observability.emptyCause: Recompute now to sample current orchestration telemetry.
observability.recomputeNote: Computed on demand from real orchestration trace data — no continuously-running telemetry worker is wired up yet.
observability.degradedSummary: ⁨{service}⁩ is degraded — its circuit breaker is configured under ⁨{location}⁩.

privacy.heading: Privacy & data
privacy.consentLedgerLabel: Maintain a consent ledger per user
privacy.honourErasureLabel: Honour erasure requests (right to be forgotten)
privacy.statutoryCarveOutNote: Applies to transcripts and derived memory. Transaction records follow the statutory 7-year rule regardless of this setting.
privacy.retentionSweepNote: Runs a real purge against transcripts and derived memory older than the configured retention window. Transaction records are always skipped and counted, never deleted.
privacy.erasureEmptyCause: A right-to-be-forgotten request will appear here once received.

guardrails.signInPrompt: Sign in to manage the global policy catalogue.
guardrails.permissionDeniedHeading: You don't have access to this screen
guardrails.permissionDeniedBody: Managing guardrails and policies requires the same governance permission as environments, promotions and the audit log.

policies.caption: Global policies
policies.lockedNote: Structurally locked — no role can change this.
policies.emptyCause: The platform policy catalogue hasn't been seeded in this environment.
policies.valueJsonHelp: A real JSON object or array — a bare value on its own, such as true or 0.6, is not accepted.
policies.floorHelp: This policy has a platform floor — a per-agent override may not go below it.
policies.invalidJsonError: This is not valid JSON, or is a bare value rather than an object or array.

updateError.policy_locked: This policy is locked and cannot be changed.
updateError.invalid_value: This is not valid JSON, or is a bare value rather than an object or array.

overrides.caption: Per-agent overrides
overrides.emptyCause: No agent currently deviates from a platform policy.

modes.heading: Execution modes
modes.body: How the router serves one prompt with one or more agents. Selecting a mode below shows what it means — this tenant's real, active mode is always badged, regardless of which one you're reading about.

Sequential.label: Sequential
Sequential.description: The router selects a single agent — the best match for the prompt — and that agent alone produces the reply. No other agent is invoked for this turn.
Sequential.traceExample: Example: a billing question routes to the billing agent, which answers on its own.

Parallel.label: Parallel
Parallel.description: The router runs the primary agent and one secondary agent at the same time, then merges both replies. Fastest option, with some risk of overlapping or conflicting content.
Parallel.traceExample: Example: a billing question also covered by a knowledge agent runs both at once, then merges their replies.

SupervisorWorker.label: Supervisor–worker
SupervisorWorker.description: The router runs up to two worker agents first, then the primary agent reviews their combined output as a supervisor before replying. Most controlled option, at the highest token cost.
SupervisorWorker.traceExample: Example: two worker agents gather information in turn; the supervising agent reviews both before responding.
